pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark brown regions featuring high-frequency edge serration and jagged pixel gradients. Spatial area is heterogeneous, with larger, more complex shapes on the posterior flank transitioning to smaller, more elongated shapes toward the anterior neck region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored negative space forming a topological mesh. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness, generally narrowing at junctions. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-point or quadri-point convergences.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the superior neck contour as a dark, tufted silhouette. The profile shows a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged edge against the blurred background, consistent with coarse hair bundles.
